arguments.subject: Billing notice vs. final status of case MC-270225-184
arguments.body:
Hello,

I’m writing about today’s January 1, 2028 mobile billing notice, which lists a $78 base plan plus a $10 Premium voicemail charge and references closed case MC-270225-184.

The final status of case MC-270225-184 was that the disputed $10 credit was applied, Premium voicemail remained disabled, and my base plan remained $68 per month. Please reconcile this notice with that final case resolution. In particular, please explain why the notice shows a $10 Premium voicemail charge and a $78 base plan, correct the statement/account if these charges are inconsistent with the resolution, and confirm the add-on remains disabled and my $68 plan is unchanged. I am not requesting any change to my plan or service.

Please provide a written response and updated billing details.

Thank you
